special_notes: Oldest and most prestigious university in Uganda. Strong research culture. High employer recognition. Has a vibrant innovation hub - the Makerere Innovation Hub.

entry_requirements: UACE with 2 principal passes; vocational entry also accepted
special_notes: Specialises in technical and vocational education. Best for engineering and education degrees in Uganda.

entry_requirements: UACE with 2 principal passes; business background preferred
special_notes: Uganda's top business school. Produces most of the corporate sector professionals. Strong industry connections.

special_notes: Leading private university. Strong law and business programmes. Beautiful campus in Mukono.
Known for tourism and hospitality management. Near Entebbe airport.
Catholic university with strong ethics focus. Good development studies programme.

special_notes: One of Uganda's largest private universities. Known for medicine and nursing programmes. Multiple campuses.
Modern campus in Kampala. Growing technology programmes.
Affiliated with Cavendish University UK. Good for business and IT.
Formerly International Health Sciences University. Strong health sciences focus.
Main public university in northern Uganda. Important for regional development.

special_notes: Public university specialising in science and technology. Growing engineering department.
